data.text: docs/research/probe-b-outreach.md is a send library, not documentation: every message exists as an EN and a UA variant, and the UA half is what actually gets sent to a Ukrainian recipient. The docs-to-English migration translated it and turned the file into a duplicate of its own English column. Restored from backup by line number. Any future sweep over docs/ has to tell a document about the work from an artefact used in it.
